verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe skills as folders containing a SKILL.md with task-specific instructions that the agent follows, framing them as reusable packages that extend what the agent can do. Users can create or download fully customizable skills, configure them via CLI slash commands, bundle them into namespaced plugins, and layer them into the Python Agent SDK. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that custom skills work as documented.
